title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF strengthened the integration of social services to address multidimensional child poverty and violence. Key achievements included finalizing case management tools, adoption of PRIMERO, expanding the child protection workforce, supporting the national child helpline, and generating evidence on school violence, and the economic impact of violence against children
